title: Prefix Boxes
rule: A prefix is a beginning added before a base word, like un and re. Draw a box around the whole prefix.
trickText: Find the base word first. Then look at the beginning that was added in front of it. Box only the prefix.
say: Today's case: prefixes. A prefix is a beginning added in front of a base word. First find the base word. Then put a box around the beginning.

example.say: Look at undo. The base word is do. The beginning u n was added in front. So I put a box around u n.

activities.instruction: Find the base word. Then box the prefix.

items.answer: u# n# l o c k
u# n# f a i r
u# n# s a f e
r# e# p l a y
r# e# r e a d
r# e# b u i l d
